title: 🔆🔅Latest footage of Strait of Hormuz still being closed, August 2nd.
text:
🔆🔅Latest footage of Strait of Hormuz still being closed, August 2nd."

"Informed Sources Deny Alleged Plan to Reopen Strait of Hormuz"

"Some media outlets had claimed that the Islamic Republic of Iran had agreed to a plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. However, informed sources have rejected these allegations, emphasizing that no change has been made in Iran's policy regarding this strategic waterway."

"A source close to Iran's negotiating team, speaking to Fars News Agency's political correspondent, denied the reports about Iran agreeing to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, stating: *"The Islamic Republic of Iran has not reached any agreement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and the news published in this regard is false."*"

"Meanwhile, a follow-up inquiry by a Fars reporter from a military informed source also indicated that the claim is untrue and entirely denied."

"This military source rejected the published reports, stressing: *"As long as America's hostile actions and provocations continue, the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed. Transit will only be possible through the designated route, in coordination with the IRGC Navy and after obtaining a permit to cross the strait. Otherwise, other routes are unsafe, and any vessels attempting to traverse them will certainly face incidents."*"

"The informed source further emphasized that the claims regarding Iran's agreement to any plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz are baseless, and that no decision or change has been made in the Islamic Republic of Iran's policies concerning this strategic waterway."

"Hours earlier, some media, citing Israeli journalist Barak Ravid, had published reports claiming that Iran had agreed to a plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz—under which ships would enter the Persian Gulf through Iranian territorial waters and exit through Omani territorial waters.
